"""只追加Round11证据，JSON转义保留原始UTF8字节及换行。"""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
out = root / 'docs/reports/translation-round11-evidence'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
groups = sorted(path for path in (root / '.local').glob('round11*') if path.is_dir())
index = {'format': 'cloudleaf-round11-raw-evidence-v1', 'at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
         'implementation_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root).decode().strip(),
         'scope': 'UTF8文本按JSON转义保存，解码utf8字段即原字节；二进制用base64。旧证据不修改。', 'groups': [], 'excluded_large_files': []}
for group in groups:
    files = []
    for path in sorted(group.rglob('*')):
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        row = {'path': path.relative_to(root).as_posix(), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
        if len(raw) > 2 * 1024 * 1024:
            index['excluded_large_files'].append(row | {'reason': '合法数据投影保留本地，Git只登记身份，不再分发完整词典'})
            continue
        try:
            row['utf8'] = raw.decode('utf-8')
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            row['base64'] = base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii')
        files.append(row)
    name = group.name + '.json'
    encoded = (json.dumps({'files': files}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
    (out / name).write_bytes(encoded)
    index['groups'].append({'file': name, 'entries': len(files), 'bytes': len(encoded), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()})
tools = []
for path in sorted((root / '.local').glob('*.py')):
    if 'round11' in path.name:
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        tools.append({'path': path.relative_to(root).as_posix(), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'utf8': raw.decode('utf-8')})
(out / 'execution-tools.json').write_text(json.dumps({'files': tools}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
index['execution_tools_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256((out / 'execution-tools.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for name in ['round11-toolchain-identities.json', 'round11-baseline-prs.json']:
    path = root / '.local' / name
    if path.exists():
        (out / name).write_text(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
for source in ['.local/round11-dictionary-real/package/export-report.json', '.local/round11-dictionary-real/package-second/export-report.json']:
    name = 'real-export-' + ('second' if 'package-second' in source else 'first') + '.json'
    (out / name).write_text((root / source).read_text(encoding='utf-8'), encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
index['changed_files_from_shared'] = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', '83a2666fa748b4ae9cba41a5880ba5353e71c9a3', 'HEAD'], cwd=root).decode('utf-8').splitlines()
index['original_input_and_types_unchanged'] = not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '83a2666fa748b4ae9cba41a5880ba5353e71c9a3', 'HEAD', '--', 'crates/cloudleaf-input', 'crates/cloudleaf-types'], cwd=root)
(out / 'index.json').write_text(json.dumps(index, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
for group in index['groups']:
    path = out / group['file']
    for row in json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['files']:
        raw = row['utf8'].encode('utf-8') if 'utf8' in row else base64.b64decode(row['base64'])
        assert len(raw) == row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == row['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'groups': len(index['groups']), 'excluded_catalogs': len(index['excluded_large_files']), 'unchanged_core': index['original_input_and_types_unchanged']}))

"""为R11新提交保存一次精确push CI快照；旧记录不覆盖。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import subprocess
import urllib.request

credential_result = subprocess.run(['git', '-c', 'credential.interactive=never', 'credential', 'fill'],
    input=b'protocol=https\nhost=github.com\n\n', stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=30)
if credential_result.returncode:
    raise RuntimeError('已有Git凭据不可用；未请求远程修改或保存凭据内容')
credential = dict(line.split('=', 1) for line in credential_result.stdout.decode('utf-8').splitlines() if '=' in line)
authorization = 'Bearer ' + credential['password']

label, commit, run_id = sys.argv[1:]
run_id = int(run_id)
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round11-ci' / label
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
API = 'https://api.github.com/repos/WanFengQC/Cloudleaf'
record = {'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'head_sha': commit, 'run_id': run_id,
          'authentication': 'Existing Git credential, process memory only; connector lists PR events only; exact push metadata uses official REST', 'tool_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'HTTP_responses': [], 'verified_pass': False}


def fetch(suffix, name):
    url = API + suffix
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json', 'User-Agent': 'Cloudleaf-Round11-exact-push-CI', 'Authorization': authorization})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=45) as response:
        raw = response.read()
        record['HTTP_responses'].append({'url': url, 'status': response.status, 'file': name, 'bytes': len(raw),
                                         'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'headers': dict(response.headers)})
    (OUT / name).write_bytes(raw)
    return json.loads(raw)


try:
    runs = fetch(f'/actions/runs?head_sha={commit}&event=push&per_page=10', 'runs.json')
    run = fetch(f'/actions/runs/{run_id}', 'run.json')
    jobs = fetch(f'/actions/runs/{run_id}/jobs?per_page=100', 'jobs.json')['jobs']
    artifacts = fetch(f'/actions/runs/{run_id}/artifacts?per_page=100', 'artifacts.json')['artifacts']
    assert any(value['id'] == run_id and value['head_sha'] == commit and value['event'] == 'push' for value in runs['workflow_runs'])
    assert run['head_sha'] == commit and run['event'] == 'push'
    record.update({'url': run['html_url'], 'event': run['event'], 'status': run['status'], 'conclusion': run['conclusion']})
    record['jobs'] = [{'id': value['id'], 'name': value['name'], 'head_sha': value['head_sha'], 'status': value['status'],
                       'conclusion': value['conclusion'], 'steps': len(value['steps']),
                       'steps_ok': all(step['conclusion'] in ('success', 'skipped') for step in value['steps'])} for value in jobs]
    record['artifacts'] = [{'id': value['id'], 'name': value['name'], 'head_sha': value['workflow_run']['head_sha'],
                            'expired': value['expired'], 'digest': value.get('digest')} for value in artifacts]
    jobs_ok = len(jobs) == 2 and {value['name'] for value in jobs} == {'core (windows-latest)', 'core (ubuntu-latest)'}
    jobs_ok = jobs_ok and all(value['head_sha'] == commit and value['status'] == 'completed' and value['conclusion'] == 'success'
                              and all(step['conclusion'] in ('success', 'skipped') for step in value['steps']) for value in jobs)
    artifacts_ok = len(artifacts) == 2 and {value['name'] for value in artifacts} == {'core-performance-windows-latest', 'core-performance-ubuntu-latest'}
    artifacts_ok = artifacts_ok and all(not value['expired'] and value['workflow_run']['head_sha'] == commit
                                        and value.get('digest', '').startswith('sha256:') for value in artifacts)
    record['verified_pass'] = run['status'] == 'completed' and run['conclusion'] == 'success' and jobs_ok and artifacts_ok
except Exception as error:
    record['error'] = {'type': type(error).__name__, 'message': str(error)}
    raise
finally:
    (OUT / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({name: value for name, value in record.items() if name != 'HTTP_responses'}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

                        input=b'protocol=https\nhost=github.com\n\n', capture_output=True, timeout=30)

    raise RuntimeError('已有Git凭据不可用')

"""为未随crate归档的许可取得Cargo固定VCS提交原件，只写审阅缓存。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import urllib.request

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
folder=root/'.local/round11-dependency-review'
out=folder/'upstream-license-originals'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
missing=json.loads((folder/'missing-license-originals.json').read_bytes())
rows=[]
for package in missing:
    repository=package['repository']
    assert repository.startswith('https://github.com/')
    commit=package['vcs']['git']['sha1']
    owner_repo=repository.removeprefix('https://github.com/')
    for name in ['LICENSE-MIT','LICENSE-APACHE']:
        url=f'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{owner_repo}/{commit}/{name}'
        request=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'Cloudleaf-Round11-license-review'})
        row={'package':package['package'],'version':package['version'],'vcs_commit':commit,'url':url,
             'name':f'{package["package"]}-{package["version"]}-{name}', 'fetched_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=30) as response:
                raw=response.read()
                row.update(status=response.status,headers=dict(response.headers),bytes=len(raw),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
            raw.decode('utf-8')
            (out/row['name']).write_bytes(raw)
        except Exception as error:
            row.update(error=type(error).__name__,message=str(error))
            rows.append(row)
            (out/'responses.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
            raise
        rows.append(row)
        (out/'responses.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'files':len(rows),'all_200':all(row['status']==200 for row in rows)}))

"""生成精确依赖政策和原件复制计划；此阶段只写本地审阅材料。"""

import json

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
folder=root/'.local/round11-dependency-review'

packages=[p for p in meta['packages'] if p['id'] not in meta['workspace_members']]

"""从已核元数据和固定原件生成精确政策/许可副本，不手改生成文件。"""

import hashlib
import json
import shutil

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
review=root/'.local/round11-dependency-review'
out=root/'licenses/translation'
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)

rows=[]
for item in plan:
    target=root/item['file']
    source=Path(item['original_path'])
    assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==item['sha256']
    shutil.copyfile(source,target)
    rows.append({key:item[key] for key in ['package','version','license','file','bytes','sha256']} | {'origin':'crate','source_name':source.name})

    target=out/item['name']
    shutil.copyfile(path,target)
    package=by_package[(item['package'],item['version'])]

        'file':target.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':item['sha256'],
        'origin':'upstream-pinned-vcs','vcs_commit':item['vcs_commit'],'url':item['url'],
        'source_name':item['name'].removeprefix(item['package']+'-'+item['version']+'-')})
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
(out/'upstream-acquisition.json').write_bytes((upstream/'responses.json').read_bytes())
shutil.copyfile(review/'policy-plan.json',root/'config/audits/translation.json')

    row={'command':command,'returncode':result.returncode,'seconds':time.perf_counter()-started}
    for stream in ['stdout','stderr']:
        raw=getattr(result,stream)
        path=out/f'{i}-{stream}.txt'
        path.write_bytes(raw)
        row[stream]={'path':str(path),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
    rows.append(row)
    (out/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'i':i,'returncode':result.returncode}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(any(row['returncode'] for row in rows))

"""逐条保存在线提供者真实本地回归，不连接外部翻译服务。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
out = root / '.local' / sys.argv[1]
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PATH'] = str(Path.home() / '.cargo/bin') + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
env['PYTHONUTF8'] = '1'
commands = [
    ['cargo', 'fmt', '-p', 'cloudleaf-translation'],
    ['cargo', 'test', '-p', 'cloudleaf-translation', '--test', 'online', '--locked', '--offline'],
    ['cargo', 'clippy', '-p', 'cloudleaf-translation', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline', '--', '-D', 'warnings'],
]
report = {'head': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root).decode().strip(),
          'started_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'commands': [],
          'runner_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          'source_sha256': {str(p.relative_to(root)).replace('\\', '/'): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                            for p in [root / 'crates/cloudleaf-translation/src/online.rs', root / 'crates/cloudleaf-translation/src/secret.rs', root / 'crates/cloudleaf-translation/tests/online.rs']},
          'initial_old_dependency_check': 'First cargo check succeeded on prior RustSec-rejected dependency versions; tool transcript only, not original byte capture; not acceptance'}
for index, args in enumerate(commands, 1):
    args[0] = shutil.which(args[0], path=env['PATH']) or args[0]
    start = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=root, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    row = {'command': args, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'seconds': time.perf_counter() - start}
    for name, raw in [('stdout', result.stdout), ('stderr', result.stderr)]:
        path = out / f'command-{index:02}-{name}.txt'
        path.write_bytes(raw)
        row[name] = {'file': path.name, 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
    report['commands'].append(row)
    (out / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    print(json.dumps({'command': index, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'seconds': row['seconds']}), flush=True)
    if result.returncode:
        break
raise SystemExit(0 if len(report['commands']) == len(commands) and all(row['returncode'] == 0 for row in report['commands']) else 1)
